chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Abu Abdillah, from his father, peace be upon them both:
That he used to forbid that the walnuts which children bring from gambling be eaten, and he said: it is suht.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.السَّكُونِيُّ: Al-Sakuni, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat food or property obtained through gambling in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that food acquired through gambling is forbidden to consume, even when it appears in a minor form such as walnuts brought by children. It emphasizes that gains from unlawful means are treated as illicit wealth and are not permissible for use.
